scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:admin
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply agendafacil-cf1-local --local --config wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute agendafacil-cf1-local --local --config wrangler.public.jsonc --file seed/0001_demo.sql
scripts.client:validate:all: node scripts/client.mjs validate studio-cut && node scripts/client.mjs validate lumiere && node scripts/client.mjs validate fixture-neutra && node scripts/client.mjs validate template
scripts.production:dryrun: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.studio-cut.public.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/production-studio-cut-public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.studio-cut.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/production-studio-cut-admin && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.lumiere.public.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/production-lumiere-public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.lumiere.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/production-lumiere-admin
scripts.staging:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply agendafacil-staging-db --remote --config wrangler.staging.public.jsonc
scripts.staging:seed: wrangler d1 execute agendafacil-staging-db --remote --config wrangler.staging.public.jsonc --file seed/0001_demo.sql
scripts.check:bundles:verticals: node scripts/check-bundles.mjs --tenant studio-cut && node scripts/check-bundles.mjs --tenant lumiere
scripts.staging:dryrun:verticals: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.studio-cut.public.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/studio-cut-public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.studio-cut.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/studio-cut-admin && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.lumiere.public.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/lumiere-public && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.lumiere.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/dryrun/lumiere-admin
scripts.staging:deploy:studio-cut: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.studio-cut.public.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.studio-cut.admin.jsonc
scripts.staging:deploy:lumiere: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.lumiere.public.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.lumiere.admin.jsonc
